title: Self-contained 7/2 bound for one total input-specified quotient-ring family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total quotient-ring language defined in proof.md Section 1. At input length N, let k be the least prime with k^3>8*N^2; output 0 for N=0 or k>=N. Otherwise the first k input bits give monic Q(T), the remaining m=N-k bits give padded r=ceil(m/k) quotient-ring blocks z_i in F_2[T]/(Q), t=ceil(sqrt(r)), e_i=r+1-i. Let S=Sym_r^t(z_i^(2^(e_i+1)-1)) and output the constant coefficient of sum_(j=0)^(k-1) S^(2^j). Every monic Q is permitted; the fixed evaluator uses polynomial-time ring arithmetic and empty NP witnesses.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform P family, hence NP with witness bound zero, in the full B2 model at actual total input length N, C_B2(f_N)>=(7/2)N-O(N^(5/6)) for every sufficiently large integer N, and therefore liminf C_B2(f_N)/N>=7/2.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
